name: get_glossary
description:
Gets a Business Glossary from the Knowledge Catalog (formerly known as Dataplex).

A Business Glossary is a curated collection of business terms and categories that describe data assets. Use this method to retrieve a glossary's display name, description and other metadata when a glossary or one of its terms is referenced by an Entry (for example, via a `definition` Entry Link returned by `lookup_entry_links`).

glossaryId.description: Required. The ID of the Glossary, i.e. the last segment of the Glossary resource name `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/glossaries/{glossary_id}`.

location.description: Required. The location of the Glossary, for example `global` or `us-central1`.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID or number that owns the Glossary.
